name: MMSU
intro: MMSU 是大规模多任务语音理解与推理基准，包含 5,000 道音频选择题与 47 项任务，覆盖感知、推理、音系、语义和副语言现象。数据由语言学专家设计、三类音频来源、五组双人标注员的 2–3 轮交叉复核及专家终审构成；论文 v3 评测 12 个 SpeechLLM 与 10 个 OmniLLM。
org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 语音数据, 专家整理
task_type: 音频理解, 语音问答
eval_feature: 语音理解, 语言学现象, 感知与推理
eval_feature_en: Spoken understanding, linguistic phenomena, perception and reasoning
intro_en: MMSU is a massive multitask spoken-language understanding and reasoning benchmark with 5,000 audio MCQs across 47 tasks. Its expert-designed linguistic framework, three audio-source routes, 2–3 shuffled cross-review rounds by five two-person annotator groups, and expert final review cover perception, reasoning, phonology, semantics, and paralinguistics; paper v3 evaluates 12 SpeechLLMs and 10 OmniLLMs.

drawio_review_note: Primary-source audit pins arXiv:2506.04779v3 (2026-03-16; PDF SHA-256 f07121645670c3d9b78340a7a4ec0e3116fd8820a32cf9e1ddafb59a724998a2), the official dingdongwang/MMSU repository at 217d1d3f5ad59203ed16f44c0fd913f4f8add2b4, its evaluator implementation commit 698fac8b7d1b7295cd6688e9fa7197ed34ec155e, and the public ddwang2000/MMSU Hugging Face snapshot 548e2283105825bf908a7db5c09c00dbcf42bd4c. paper_url and arxiv_pdf_url are locked to v3 because v1 reports 14 models while v3 reports the 22-model evaluation shown here. Paper v3 defines four construction stages: linguistics-expert framework and 47-task design; textbook/online MCQ curation plus expertise-guided GPT-4o candidate-option augmentation; authentic-first audio collection; and manual review. Audio-source totals are exactly 3,837 open-source clips (76.74%), 672 custom recordings (13.44%), and 491 Azure TTS clips (9.82%). Professional actors target missing phonological cues; 15 diverse real speakers cover a small semantic subset; Azure uses 20 voices. Section 3.2 states that low-quality or ambiguous samples are filtered out or refined. The appendix makes the retained-sample quality loop explicit: 10 annotators form five pairs, each pair independently reviews 1,000 items against audio relevance, question validity, distractor quality, and answer accuracy; any retained flagged item is re-recorded, rewritten, or has choices revised and then returns to the same pair; after all 5,000 pass, the dataset is shuffled and each 1,000-item batch goes to a different pair; this repeats for 2–3 rounds until no objections remain; three linguistics experts and the research team then make no more than 20 minor adjustments. The final dataset contains 5,000 MCQs across 47 tasks, split into 2,580 perception and 2,420 reasoning questions, with mean audio length 7.01 seconds. The pinned HF snapshot is public and ungated, declares MIT, exposes one 5,000-row train split, and has 13 fields: id, task_name, 16-kHz audio, question, choice_a through choice_d, answer_gt, category, sub-category, sub-sub-category, and linguistics_sub_discipline. Paper-v3 evaluation covers 12 SpeechLLMs and 10 OmniLLMs, randomizes and balances A–D answer positions, uses the same optimized instruction-following prompt for all models, and reports accuracy; the exact paper-time response parser, decoding parameters, random seed, and full prompt text are not disclosed. The current official inference scaffold downloads the HF dataset without a revision pin, fixes an A–D-only prompt, leaves model integration and decoding to the user, and writes JSONL. Its evaluator skips malformed JSON lines and response-normalization exceptions; accepts only uppercase A–D at the first character or, when length exceeds one, at the second-last character; maps the selected letter to choice text and requires exact equality with answer_gt; counts empty or literal None responses wrong; skips other nonempty malformed responses entirely; and therefore excludes those skipped rows from the denominator. It does not join by id, enforce 5,000 unique rows, or reject duplicates/unknown rows. Category, sub-category, and overall results are micro accuracies over accepted rows. The HF dataset card declares MIT, while the official GitHub repository itself contains no root LICENSE file. Source-dataset revisions and sampling rules, GPT-4o snapshot/decoding, pre-filter candidate counts, per-item provenance/rights mapping, and paper-time evaluator code remain undisclosed boundaries. EN/ZH specs preserve identical IDs, types, positions, and edges. Formal publication evidence [site-a11p-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3479×1321 (English) and 3472×1321 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3477×1319 and 3470×1319. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
